package com.solo.events.domain.aggregate;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public record UnknownEventData(
    String status,
    Integer level,
    Object mode,
    String kind,
    String version,
    String flag
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UnknownEventData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UnknownEventData(
            (String) map.get("status"),
            (Integer) map.get("level"),
            (Object) map.get("mode"),
            (String) map.get("kind"),
            (String) map.get("version"),
            (String) map.get("flag")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("status", status);
        map.put("level", level);
        map.put("mode", mode);
        map.put("kind", kind);
        map.put("version", version);
        map.put("flag", flag);
        return map;
    }
}
